### Findings
Across all recorded history with no date filter applied, the observed `sale_price` range for items with status `'Complete'` within the authorized product scope (products 2 and 3, enforced by executor-bound views) spans from 20.0 to 30.0 [q1].

| min_price | max_price |

### Limitations
- The query did not return item counts or order frequencies, so the distribution of sales across this price range is unknown [q1].
- Product identifiers, catalogue reference prices (`retail_price`), and costs were not retrieved, meaning product-level pricing variation and margins were not measured [q1].

### Action items (proposed)
- Query the count of completed items and average `sale_price` grouped by `product_id` to observe item volume across authorized products.
- Compare observed completed `sale_price` against catalogue `retail_price` and `cost` from `products` to evaluate price realization and cost proxies.
